notes.title: Patch V1.07
notes.content:
Patch V1.07

Minor patch to fix some issues. 

1.07
-clickable area for upgrades is much bigger.
-added TAB for map instructions to the intitial keys guide.
-nerfed snakes no longer drop upgrade points.

notes.title: Patch V1.06
notes.content:
Update V1.06

Over the past year I have received great support and feedback from players and fellow devs. They inspired me to return to the game and update it to be more friendly and fun for the player, and a more streamlined and logical experience. Major improvements being a proper in game tutorial, simplified upgrade system and refined player controls.

I want to thank developers JustWall Games, Mika Pyon and Ryan Kwok, for encouraging me to dive back in, and for taking so much time with DROJ to test and give feedback.

1.06
-added optional in game tutorial system to explain most game mechanics.
-streamlined player upgrades to one currency type instead of two different ones. Mine purple gems and upgrade your player in the ship.
-reworked jet pack to have much more control.
-Improvements to map generation with 'fluffier' asteroids, more tunnels, and more chance for some giant asteroids. 
-added blue small oxygen drops.
-zoom camera with mouse wheel.
-sub boss balancing.
-cash balancing.
-oxygen and fuel balancing.
-removed unused double click to lock fire.
-many minor bug fixes.
-more secret things.

notes.title: Patch V1.05
notes.content:
Update v1.05
More tutorials and tweaks to easy mode as per player feedback.

-added second help screen to escape menu
-added health bar for bosses
-less jetpack drain in easy mode
-more jet pack maneuverability in easy mode (players start with two points in the jetpack skill instead of one)
-more secret things!

Albatross Wirehead

notes.title: Patch v1.04
notes.content:
Update v1.04
I received a lot of player feedback around the game not having enough tutorials and information on how to play. This patch hopes to address those concerns and hopefully increase enjoyment of the game for players.

-Added game guide to esc menu. The game guide is a run down on core game mechanics and controls.
-Added more in game help indicators.
-Improved loading screen guides.

Albatross Wirehead

notes.title: Patch V1.01
notes.content:
A quick patch that makes new games default to easy mode, this is to help new players not be punished so hard while they learn the ropes. Easy mode is more casual, it gives you 99 lives and softens enemies, increases starting stats etc. Of course you can still choose normal or hard modes before beginning a game.

Normal and Hard modes are highly recommended if you are looking for a challenge.

-Albatross
